_: ONE table, read by both readers of a milestone's order (docs/hub/milestones.md). A milestone's membership is each card's **Milestone:** line; its ORDER is <Space>/milestones/<slug>.md, whose ## Order bullets, in line order, are the rank. ranked: the file's ids (a bullet's first word, each once, up to the next heading) that a card carrying that milestone still answers, in file order. unranked: the members the file does not list, by created oldest first, a card with no date last, ties by id (ordinal). stale: how many of the file's ids answered no member -- no card, or a card naming another milestone; a reader never deletes one. A milestone matches a card's line exactly, case and all. Each row's lines are the file, joined with LF, or CRLF when crlf is true; no lines is no file. cards are the Space's open cards (current/ and backlog/) as id, milestone, created. slugs: the file's name, the title slugged the way a card slug is (lowercase, runs of anything but a-z0-9 one hyphen, trimmed, at most 60). Scripts/Get-MilestoneOrder.ps1 Get-P20MilestoneOrder and ConvertTo-P20MilestoneSlug (tkTestToolkit -Plan) and agent/core/parsers.py milestone_order() and milestone_slug() (Tests/test_parsers.py).
